title: Psychedelic Delusion to True Reality
coreRelationships: The alternating red, black, and white bands create a strong sense of rotation and depth.
The narrowing of the bands towards the center emphasizes the vortex effect.
The dark circular overlay contrasts with the vibrant spiral, suggesting an interruption or a different plane.
The overall composition is dominated by the dynamic spiral, drawing the eye inward.
The high contrast between the colors enhances the visual impact and illusion.
reuseFormula: Create a high-contrast, multi-color spiral vortex with bands that narrow towards a bright center. Introduce a large, dark, semi-transparent circular overlay in the upper left quadrant of the vortex to add a secondary visual element and disrupt the continuous spiral pattern.
